name: Shelly Pro 3EM-3CT63
summary: DIN-rail 1/3-phase energy meter with combined 63 A CT, Ethernet/Wi-Fi, Modbus, 60-day log.

f.inputs: 3 L + N voltage inputs, 3 CT inputs + optional neutral CT
requires: DIN rail in a panel or enclosure

extra.ct: 3CT63 combined 3-phase CT, Ø9 mm apertures, mounts over a breaker
extra.relay: none; contactor via Pro 3EM Switch Add-on

gotchas: 63 A CT with Ø9 mm apertures — branch/sub-feed only; can't clamp 100-200 A US service conductors (pick a larger-CT Pro 3EM variant)
Combined 3CT63 is designed to sit over a (DIN) breaker; awkward in US plug-on panels
No relay — load control needs the Pro 3EM Switch Add-on
Channel-to-channel calibration needs ≥500 W per channel; <30 VA loads not accumulated
best_for: Sub-panel, PV inverter or 3-phase circuit monitoring ≤63 A with Modbus/Ethernet
